description: Figure 3 illustrates the performance of different logical synthesis modules across varying levels of task complexity, as measured by accuracy. The horizontal axis represents the task complexity levels—Simple, Moderate, and Challenging—as well as a Total average, with categories arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled in percentage points, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Four bars are present for each complexity level, representing the performance of different modules: DIN-SQL (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), DIN-SQL (few-shot), and NatSQL. The bars are color-coded, with DIN-SQL (zero-shot) in dark blue, TA-SQL (zero-shot) in light blue, DIN-SQL (few-shot) in orange, and NatSQL in green. For the Simple complexity level, the accuracy values are approximately 92.31% for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), 91.24% for TA-SQL (zero-shot), 89.59% for DIN-SQL (few-shot), and 80.40% for NatSQL. In the Moderate complexity level, the values are approximately 80.62% for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), 81.08% for TA-SQL (zero-shot), 75.34% for DIN-SQL (few-shot), and 56.19% for NatSQL. For the Challenging complexity level, the values are approximately 63.14% for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), 60.21% for TA-SQL (zero-shot), 61.38% for DIN-SQL (few-shot), and 39.64% for NatSQL. Finally, for the Total average, the values are approximately 75.34% for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), 73.34% for TA-SQL (zero-shot), 75.34% for DIN-SQL (few-shot), and 56.19% for NatSQL. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
